item.title: Town of Surf City continues hydrant replacements, water outage planned
item.description: The Town of Surf City Public Utilities Department will continue hydrant replacements throughout the month of January.

item.title: ‘Severe’ geomagnetic storm could make northern lights visible in southern US
item.description: A strong geomagnetic storm could soon interact with Earth's atmosphere, bringing the potential for northern lights displays to be seen much further south in the continental U.S., according to space weather experts.

item.title: Brandon Bussi makes 17 saves for his 18th win as the Hurricanes beat the Sabres 2-1
item.description: Brandon Bussi made 17 saves for his 18th win of the season, Seth Jarvis scored the go-ahead goal on a power play early in the third period and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Buffalo Sabres 2-1 on Monday.

item.title: Community comes together to celebrate Dr. King’s legacy in Wilmington
item.description: On a day that honors the achievements of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., hundreds gathered in downtown Wilmington Monday to reflect on his legacy of nonviolent activism for civil rights and his impact on American society.

item.title: New diner opens in Burgaw; Culinary competition sparks downtown business boom
item.description: It’s been a couple of weeks since a new diner opened in Burgaw and it joins several other businesses that have also come to the downtown area.

item.title: Christian leaders urge protecting worshippers’ rights after protesters interrupt service
item.description: Several faith leaders called urgently for protecting the rights of worshippers while also expressing compassion for migrants after anti-immigration enforcement protesters disrupted a service at a Southern Baptist church in Minnesota.

item.title: Bills fire coach Sean McDermott after 9 seasons of falling short of reaching the Super Bowl
item.description: Sean McDermott arrived in Buffalo in 2017, envisioning the day of looking out his office window and seeing a throng of fans celebrating a Super Bowl victory.

item.title: US Catholic cardinals urge Trump administration to embrace a moral compass in foreign policy
item.description: Three U.S. Catholic cardinals urged the Trump administration on Monday to use a moral compass in pursuing its foreign policy, saying U.S. military action in Venezuela, threats of acquiring Greenland and cuts in foreign aid risk bringing vast suffering instead of promoting peace.

item.title: NHC Landfill to be filled within 30 years, according to presentation
item.description: During last week's New Hanover County Commissioners' agenda review meeting, county recycling and solid waste director Joe Suleyman gave a presentation about the future of the county landfill.

item.title: Warming Shelter ILM opens for 2nd of 3 straight nights
item.description: Dozens of people lined up outside Grace United Methodist Church early Monday night as they waited for the shelter to open.
